```renyi
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products whose stock is below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.json

type Product
  purpose: A product record loaded from the inventory file.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

type InventoryError is one of
  purpose: A problem that prevents the inventory report from running.
  MissingPath
  FileReadFailed(path: Text)
  InvalidProducts
end

public function main() or fails with InventoryError
  needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Print low-stock products from the JSON file named by the first argument.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath

  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with FileReadFailed(path: path)
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with InvalidProducts

  let low_stock_products be
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product

  for each product in low_stock_products
    console.print("{product.name}: {product.stock} below {product.reorder_level}")
  end
end
```

```renyi
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products that need reordering.

import std.console
import std.environment as env
import std.filesystem as files
import std.json

type Product
  purpose: A product with current stock and a reorder threshold.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

type AppError is one of
  purpose: What can go wrong while reading the inventory file.
  MissingPath
  ReadFailed
  BadJson
end

function reorder_line(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Format one reorder warning line.
  example: reorder_line(Product(name: "Bolts", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)) is "Bolts: stock 2, reorder level 5"

  return "{product.name}: stock {product.stock}, reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

function products_below_reorder(products: List of Product)
  returns List of Product
  purpose: Select products whose stock is below their reorder level, lowest stock first.
  example: products_below_reorder([Product(name: "Bolts", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5), Product(name: "Nuts", stock: 8, reorder_level: 3)]) is [Product(name: "Bolts", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)]

  return
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product
end

public function main()
  or fails with AppError
  needs environment, filesystem.read, console
  purpose: Read product inventory JSON and print products below reorder level.

  let arguments be env.arguments()
  let path be arguments.at(0) otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let text be files.read_text(path) otherwise fail with ReadFailed
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson
  let low_products be products_below_reorder(products)

  for each product in low_products
    console.print(reorder_line(product))
  end
end
```

```renyi
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products whose stock is below their reorder level.

import std.console
import std.environment
import std.filesystem
import std.json

public type Product
  purpose: A product with inventory and reorder information.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer
  has reorder_level: Integer
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: A command-line inventory reporting error.
  MissingPath
  BadPath(path: Text)
  ReadFailed(path: filesystem.Path)
  BadJson(path: filesystem.Path)
end

public function reorder_lines(products: List of Product) returns List of Text
  purpose: Build report lines for products below their reorder level.
  example: reorder_lines(products: [Product(name: "Bolts", stock: 2, reorder_level: 5)]) is ["Bolts: stock 2 below reorder level 5"]

  return
    for each product in products
    where product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
    sorted by product.stock
    collect "{product.name}: stock {product.stock} below reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs console, environment, filesystem.read
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file and print reorder lines.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath
  let path be filesystem.Path(path_text) otherwise fail with BadPath(path: path_text)
  let text be filesystem.read_text(path) otherwise fail with ReadFailed(path: path)
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with BadJson(path: path)
  let lines be reorder_lines(products: products)

  for each line in lines
    console.print(line)
  end
end
```

```renyi
module inventory.reorder
  purpose: Print products whose stock is below their reorder level.

import std.console as console
import std.environment as environment
import std.filesystem as files
import std.json as json

type Product
  purpose: A product with inventory and reorder threshold.
  has name: Text
  has stock: Integer where stock is at least 0
  has reorder_level: Integer where reorder_level is at least 0
  can FromJson
end

public type AppError is one of
  purpose: A failure while reading or reporting inventory.
  MissingPath
  CannotReadFile(path: Text)
  InvalidProducts(detail: Text)
end

function needs_reorder(product: Product)
  returns Boolean
  purpose: Decide whether a product is below its reorder threshold.
  example: needs_reorder(product: Product(name: "Pens", stock: 3, reorder_level: 10)) is true

  return product.stock is less than product.reorder_level
end

function report_line(product: Product)
  returns Text
  purpose: Format one low-stock product for the command line.
  example: report_line(product: Product(name: "Pens", stock: 3, reorder_level: 10)) is "Pens: stock 3, reorder level 10"

  return "{product.name}: stock {product.stock}, reorder level {product.reorder_level}"
end

public function main() or fails with AppError
  needs environment, filesystem.read, console
  purpose: Read products from a JSON file path and print low-stock products.

  let arguments be environment.arguments()
  let path_text be arguments.first() otherwise fail with MissingPath

  let text be files.read_text(files.Path(path_text)) otherwise fail with CannotReadFile(path: path_text)
  let products: List of Product be json.parse(text) otherwise fail with InvalidProducts(detail: "expected a JSON array of products")

  let low_products be
    for each product in products
    where needs_reorder(product: product)
    sorted by product.stock
    collect product

  for each product in low_products
    console.print(report_line(product: product))
  end
end
```
